verdict.rationale: Supabase provides database branching and migrations (supabase-docs-10/17/24) which offer some schema versioning, but there is no evidence of any mechanism to version, review, or roll back AI-driven automations/agent actions themselves (e.g., an audit log or undo for MCP-executed commands). Given the recent MCP security incident (supabase-comm-1) there's also no indication of built-in rollback for agent actions.
